answer: A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a swarm in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, as each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The harbor cap is policed at intake and meadow reveals the per-origin counts. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a pigment tag. That is 4 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
